steps.content: [Desert - Daytime]
Rustle... rustle...
The sandstorm passes, and the weather clears.
A green lizard scurries across the sand, leaving a trail of tiny footprints. Not far from the lizard, Hella clutches the docked Tuco sand ship, vomiting as Korryn pats her back.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh dear, you were so spirited swinging that pipe earlier. Now look at you...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: There there, feeling better? Want some water?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... I'm never taking your ship again! What a bumpy ride... Urgh...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No probs. Next time we collab, you drive. You're way better at it than me.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Thank you for everything. Had fun working with us?
Hella turns her head awkwardly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! For folks who usually flee at the drop of a hat, y'all just had to jump in and fight with me this time, even though none of you know how to fight... Good thing we won. If anything bad happened...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Nah, I knew we'd win. After all, we had you on our side!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cut it out, I'm being serious!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I'm being serious too, Hella.
Korryn's expression softens, her eyes warm and gentle.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Just like you said, Tuco is really weak. No stable Hypercube supply, no cannons... Look, we don't even have a proper sand ship.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Of course, in a place like WhiteSands, if you want to "be strong," you can join any desert bandit group. But... some people just don't want to live like that.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: If the powerless want to live in freedom, they must band together and use their wits and bonds to survive in this dire world.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: What we've always lacked isn't strength, but companions who can carve out a future with us.
Korryn stretches out her hand, officially extending an invitation.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Haha... You always thought of me as the bad guy, and never took my invitation seriously.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Little Hella, would you like to stay and continue adventuring with us?
Hella hesitates a bit and looks towards the ship. Sure enough, the townspeople are peeking at her, quickly hiding after being spotted.
Hella's hand twitches, but ultimately doesn't take Korryn's hand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sorry, I can't stay.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I... I really like you guys, too! The car chase was a blast, and fighting desert bandits with you was awesome! I've learned so much from you, but... that's still not enough.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The world outside DisCity is nothing like I imagined—it's vast and dangerous. You guys showed me a new way to become strong. Maybe I can find other kinds of "strength" elsewhere, too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I think that's the whole point of adventure! My journey's just starting. It's not just about Tuco—there are so many places waiting for me!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'll get stronger, and bring that strength back with me—I already have a place I really want to return to, and people I want to be with forever. I've gotta get back to them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Oh geez, how cheesy of me! You're making me blush!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Is that so? Well, there's nothing I can do then.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: When you put it like that, how can I keep trying to poach you?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Is it that ${PlayerName} and Hecate you mentioned before? Seriously, anyone who can keep you thinking about them like this, I wanna meet. Bring them along next time?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sure! They're both really interesting people.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So... goodbye, then?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah, goodbye. See you around!
As they bid farewell, the roar of motorbikes comes from afar—Hella contacted the Legion after escaping from the cage, and they are coming to pick her up.
She waves vigorously at the Tuco folks, then turns around, striding forward without looking back.
A Tuco ballad echoes in the wind. It's a melody that Hella is familiar with.
Congratulations, for witnessing the most magnificent desert sunset. Congratulations, for keeping the most genuine smile in these times.
Bless you. Your adventures will guide our way forward. Your story be sung across WhiteSands!
May you always charge ahead bravely! May your journeys always be smooth!
In a daze, Hella thinks she hears Wright's familiar raspy voice. She suddenly remembers she still has Wright's portrait with her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ah, I need to return this to you...

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Ah?
In the crowd seeing her off, the "deceased" Wright is standing right there.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh... we didn't expect you to really turn around! If we'd known, we wouldn't have made it so melodramatic... Turn back around, sweetie. Just pretend you were seeing things. Keep this beautiful memory so we can...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You lying vixen!!! Korryn!!! You tricked me again!!!
[CG Farewell Moment A]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Biatch! Liar! So frigging shameless!!!!!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hahaha, the little mouse is mad! Run, run!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Of course, if you really can't bear to part with me, you can still join Tuco. You can reach out to me anytime—got it?
[CG Farewell Moment B]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: In your dreams! Damn it! You almost conned me out of my shorts!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get lost! Hella here is in high demand, I don't need an invite from you!
[CG Farewell Moment C]

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hahaha... Alright, this time it's really goodbye!
Korryn's figure almost merges into the light. Only her brightly shining eyes stand out.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Go and become stronger! Meet different people, explore new cities, and see what the world really looks like on my behalf! Let me know what's at the end of WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: It's okay to be confused. It's okay to get lost. Don't stop, keep moving forward...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ...At the end of your journey, you'll definitely find the answers you seek!
A few days later...

The desert bandit leader and security captain Scotch were dumped somewhere along the transport route by unknown individuals. They were left with only their underwear and a small amount of Hypercubes. Fighting when found, the discoverers had to exert all their strength to separate them.
At the same time, a letter is secretly delivered to the security force office. Inside, a photo of Scotch and the desert bandit fighting in their underwear is placed meticulously on top.
As for the Tuco folks...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ...Ah, it would've been perfect if we succeeded in keeping little Hella. What a pity.
A group of Tuco folks is sitting under some wanted posters, chatting nonchalantly.

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: That Legion... that's what she called it, right? Holy smokes, that convoy was really freaking something else! It looked so powerful, even from afar. Think we could drop their name if we run into trouble again?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: It's a pity that someone couldn't keep their mouth shut and had to bellow out during the farewell. Otherwise, with the Legion covering us, WhiteSands would've been our backyard!

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Hehe, well... it was just an outbreak... yeah outbreak.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Yeah you bet. Talk to my hand.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No biggie. We were doing just fine before Hella came along, weren't we?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: However...
Korryn's gaze zooms in on the wanted list, focusing on the word "DisCity."

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: DisCity... that Minos Chief is quite interesting. Should we go meet him?
steps.female_content: DisCity... that Minos Chief is quite interesting. Should we go meet her?

steps.content: [WhiteSands - Daytime]
Hella leans against the Legion's vehicle, sulking. Horo glances at her several times before finally speaking.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Come on now, cheer up. You look happy and you've become stronger, a little bit.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph, so next time you'll take me with you on a mission?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Well, even if I kick you out off the car, you'll still climb back on, so be it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hooray! I'm a big shot now, you know. I know everything about WhiteSands... all the local routes! I'll cover you from now on!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Okay.
Horo agrees nonchalantly, leaving Hella momentarily stunned.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?...Are you out of your mind? Is this a joke?
Horo doesn't respond. She just smiles and pats Hella's head.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You've indeed gotten stronger, so I guess I can use some help from you.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: After all, the <color=#fb9259>"goods"</color> the Legion needs to keep an eye on this time aren't anything sweet...
Horo takes out a file folder. Inside are many scattered clues, including a particularly strange one.
Blurry lens, a strange box, glaring patterns—the Underground's crimson mark looks extremely eerie in this picture.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Let's go. We'll see exactly who's going to send what, and where they're going to send the bogeyman this time...
Horo steps on the gas. The convoy accelerates, leaving the route and delving deeper into WhiteSands.
